title: Jarl: new records kind and priority without saying they were defaulted
claim: A task filed without --kind is recorded as kind bug with no note, while the tier default gets one; the report filed a film as a bug and saw it days later in models.

proposal: Print one defaulted note per value not given (kind, priority), as for tier.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands. True: kind falls to the profile default and is printed in the parsed line, but only tier gets a 'defaulted' note; and at a1132a8 Kind has no command to correct it afterwards, so a wrong default sticks. Covered by: 6.3.0 (was 6.2.1) #029 partly (makes Kind editable).

verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands. True and by design: --model is stored as given and Jarl keeps no list of models, so two spellings are two models in every count of models.

title: Jarl: done cannot wait for an owner's sign-off on an acceptance line
claim: An issue whose acceptance needs the owner's approval of images was set done right after its merge and had to be reopened by hand. Corrected by the sceptic: Severity medium rather than high: the early close was visible and reopened by hand, and 016's listing of unaddressed acceptance lines narrows it; the refusal itself stays the owner's decision.
evidence: set 529 done passed on the loop copy with its acceptance line addressed by no row; the gate reads a Proof row and a live approve only. Map row fr-03.
where: JarlSkill/skills/jarl/scripts/lib/commands.mjs (doneRefusalIn), at release/6.2.1 71ebc5b after the split; jarl-lib.mjs:2037 at a1132a8
proposal: Owner decision: whether done refuses while an acceptance line marked for the owner is open; issue 016 is the nearest place.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands-corrected. True: done reads a Proof row and a live approve and never an acceptance line, and the done note stays silent when rows ≥ lines; a profile slot per kind can demand a file, but not the owner's word on one issue. 016 makes done list each acceptance line no row names and ask for a reason, which would have shown the early close. Covered by: 6.3.0 (was 6.2.1) #016 partly.

title: Jarl: a batched review is not one record
claim: Four tasks shared one review and one merge SHA, and the record shows four separate reviews. Corrected by the sceptic: Severity low: the record already lets a reader group a batch from identical verdict lines; an explicit batch id only makes that exact.
evidence: review <ids> writes one verdict and one log line per issue with nothing linking them (help, the <ids> paragraph). Map row fr-05; issue 007 offers batches but adds no batch record.
where: JarlSkill/skills/jarl/scripts/lib/review.mjs (cmdReview), at release/6.2.1 71ebc5b after the split; jarl-lib.mjs:4439 at a1132a8
proposal: A multi-issue verdict carries a batch id in the log, and report shows batch sizes and later rounds per batch.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands-corrected. True that no batch id links the verdicts, but the batch is not lost: a multi-id review writes identical log lines (same minute, reviewer and findings), from which batch sizes can be rebuilt. It costs research, not the coordinator's loop. Covered by: 6.3.0 (was 6.2.1) #007 partly.

title: Jarl: relayed verdicts count as fresh reviews in report and status
claim: 65 of 136 verdicts came from a pull-request bot and were counted among fresh reviewers. Corrected by the sceptic: Kind gap and owner, not defect: count relayed apart in report and status; whether a bot's approve may clear an issue is the owner's call.
evidence: --relayed exists and models counts it per reviewer, but the fresh, coordinator and self split of report and status ignores it, so a relayed approve counts as fresh and clears the gate. Map row fr-06.
where: JarlSkill/skills/jarl/scripts/lib/metrics.mjs (metricsOf), at release/6.2.1 71ebc5b after the split; jarl-lib.mjs:4002 at a1132a8
proposal: Count relayed verdicts apart in report and status; the owner rules whether a bot's approve may clear an issue.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands-corrected. The defect framing is wrong: --relayed means only that someone else typed the reviewer's verdict, and by the help's own rule a relayed fresh reviewer is fresh, so it is meant to count. What stands is a gap and an owner question: Jarl has no class for an automated reviewer, and report and status do not count relayed verdicts apart (only models does).

title: Jarl: a stuck worker shows only after six hours without a commit
claim: Workers sat stuck on a permission prompt or idle on a shared lock while the record said in flight. Corrected by the sceptic: Severity medium rather than high: a 30-minute warning is available today through the flag; what is missing is reading the row and log ages, a goal line for the threshold, and the same threshold in resume.
evidence: A lease is idle only after STALE_HOURS (6) with no commit on its branch; the last evidence row and log line are not read, and the threshold is a flag, not a goal line. Map row fr-07.
where: JarlSkill/skills/jarl/scripts/lib/rounds.mjs (leaseProblems), at release/6.2.1 71ebc5b after the split; jarl-lib.mjs:4794 at a1132a8
proposal: Show per in-flight issue the age of its last row, commit and log line, with a warning threshold in minutes set in goal.md.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands-corrected. Partly true: idle is read from the lease's Since and the branch's last commit only, never from the last row or log line, resume has no threshold flag and always uses 6 h, and no goal line sets it. But the threshold already takes minutes: --stale-hours takes any positive number, so status --stale-hours 0.5 flags a worker with no commit for 30 min, which is the permission-prompt case.

title: Jarl: a round records no severity
claim: A round from a wording note counts the same as one from a broken export.
evidence: A changes verdict needs a Critical or Important finding, but round is free text with no severity. Map row fr-35; issue 003 adds a count of findings.
where: JarlSkill/skills/jarl/scripts/lib/review.mjs (cmdReview), at release/6.2.1 71ebc5b after the split; jarl-lib.mjs:4448 at a1132a8
proposal: round records the highest severity of the verdict that caused it, and report splits rounds by it.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands. True: round records free text only. The severity is recoverable, since a changes verdict must name Critical or Important and the verdict text before each round holds it, but nothing reads it into the round or report. Covered by: 6.3.0 (was 6.2.1) #003 partly.

title: Jarl: the coordinator's own slips are not a statistic
claim: Closing too early or merging without the gate is invisible in report. Corrected by the sceptic: The proposal narrows to counting reopens after done, retractions and the closed-gate cases in report; refused writes are not in the record to count.
evidence: report counts reopenings; refused commands and reverted states are not counted. Map row fr-36.
where: JarlSkill/skills/jarl/scripts/lib/resume.mjs (cmdReport), at release/6.2.1 71ebc5b after the split; jarl-lib.mjs:6022 at a1132a8
proposal: A report section of reopens after done, retractions and refused writes by the coordinator.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands-corrected. Partly true, and part already exists: status and resume list 'Closed, gate does not hold' with the repair command (a code issue done with no merge, a merge recorded after done), which are coordinator slips. Refused commands cannot be counted, because a refusal writes nothing to the record by design.

title: Jarl: waiting does not show that the root cause is the owner
claim: Task 30 waits on 40, which waits on the owner, and shows only 'after 40'. Corrected by the sceptic: Severity low: it hangs on fr-03/fr-41, since only an owner hold that is recorded can be followed.
evidence: resume prints '(after 010)' style lines only. Map row fr-37.
where: JarlSkill/skills/jarl/scripts/lib/resume.mjs (renderResume), at release/6.2.1 71ebc5b after the split; jarl-lib.mjs:5971 at a1132a8
proposal: Follow After to an open question on the owner and print 'waiting on the owner, via N'.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands-corrected. True: Waiting prints only '(after N)'. But the next block, Questions to the owner, names the issue of each question, so the root cause is one join away, and in the report's case (a sign-off) no record of the owner's hold exists to follow at all.

title: Jarl: no single digest of what waits on the owner
claim: The owner reads in bursts; one message with every open question and sign-off would match that.
evidence: resume lists questions and ratify items in two blocks; no digest. Map row fr-38.
where: JarlSkill/skills/jarl/scripts/lib/questions.mjs (cmdAsk), at release/6.2.1 71ebc5b after the split; jarl-lib.mjs:5540 at a1132a8
proposal: ask --digest prints open questions, ratify items and owner sign-offs in one message.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands. True: resume lists questions and ratify items in two adjacent blocks; there is no single owner-facing message.

title: Jarl: the CLI cannot say its version, so it can drift from the server unseen
claim: The CLI and the MCP tools could disagree on flags without an agent noticing. Corrected by the sceptic: The claim narrows to drift between installs; the fix is a version on the CLI, and a note when the server's and the script's versions differ.
evidence: The server reports the plugin's version; the CLI has no version command. Map row fr-39.
where: JarlSkill/skills/jarl/scripts/jarl-mcp.mjs:51 at a1132a8
proposal: jarl.mjs --version, and resume notes when the server and the script differ.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands-corrected. Half true: the CLI has no version command, but within one install the two cannot disagree, because the MCP server imports the CLI's own command tables, parser and dispatch from jarl.mjs. Drift exists only between two installs (a plugin and a separate checkout), which is the case to flag.

title: Jarl: nothing re-checks a recorded attachment after done
claim: Evidence says 'rendered 73 pages' but not where they are or whether they still exist.
evidence: evidence --file --slot records path, sha256 and size and done re-checks them, only inside the loop root and only for profile slots. Map row fr-40.
where: JarlSkill/skills/jarl/scripts/lib/evidence.mjs (cmdEvidence), at release/6.2.1 71ebc5b after the split; jarl-lib.mjs:2683 at a1132a8
proposal: verify lists recorded attachments that are gone or changed.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands. True: attachments are recorded with sha256 and size and done re-checks them on disk, only for profile slots and only under the loop root; nothing re-checks them after done.

title: Jarl: no register of what is in force or waiting on someone
claim: Standing orders, sign-offs, promises, external waits and guesses lived in chat and loose notes and were lost in compactions. Corrected by the sceptic: Severity medium rather than high: rules, decisions and questions already survive compaction; the owner's decision is about the new kinds and the ball, and 020 covers the standing brief.
evidence: Rulings, questions, ratify items and After hold part of it; promises, external waits, validity, certainty and who holds the ball do not exist. Map row fr-41; issues 020 and 005 cover small parts.
where: JarlSkill/skills/jarl/scripts/lib/questions.mjs (cmdAsk), at release/6.2.1 71ebc5b after the split; jarl-lib.mjs:5540 at a1132a8
proposal: Owner decision on the concept; loop rules (020), the owner root cause (fr-37) and the digest (fr-38) stand alone meanwhile.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands-corrected. Partly true, but most of the losses came from records not used: a standing order or a coordinator convention recorded with decide is printed under Rulings in force on every resume, and a question filed with ask survives a compaction and a cancelled dialog. Missing are the entry kinds sign-off, promise and external wait, the ball, validity and certainty. Covered by: 6.3.0 (was 6.2.1) #020 and #005 partly.

evidence: Neither merged nor scope checks added lines for conflict markers or added files for size. Map row fr-42.
where: JarlSkill/skills/jarl/scripts/lib/commands.mjs (cmdMerged), at release/6.2.1 71ebc5b after the split; jarl-lib.mjs:2108 at a1132a8
proposal: scope and merged note added lines that start a conflict marker and added files over a size.
verifier: fresh Opus sceptic, 2026-11-03, at JarlSkill a1132a8: stands. True: neither scope nor merged reads added lines for conflict markers or added files for size; the only conflict handling is the merge driver for decisions.md.
